_meta.purpose: Scope and done-criteria. The next session's work is the highest-priority FRONTIER entry: passes:false AND all blocked_by entries passed. Array order = priority.
rules: It is unacceptable to remove or edit tests because this could lead to missing or buggy functionality.
Flip passes to true ONLY after every step was actually executed and succeeded in this session — end-to-end as a user would, not unit tests alone.
Steps must be machine-checkable or directly observable: commands to run, outputs to see, flows to click through.
Out-of-scope discoveries become NEW entries here (or issues), never silent expansions of the current diff.

Entries may declare blocked_by (ids). Sessions pick only from the FRONTIER: passes:false entries whose blockers all pass. Parallel sessions: set claimed_by (session/agent name) BEFORE working and clear it when done; skip claimed entries. Parallel-safe means disjoint areas of behavior/config, not named files.
Size every entry as a tracer bullet: a narrow but COMPLETE path through every layer, demoable on its own, small enough for one fresh context window.
Durability: describe behavior and interfaces, never file paths or line numbers — they go stale.

features.description: User can sign in with email and password
steps: Create a test user, sign in through the real UI/API entry point
Wrong-password attempt is rejected with a clear error
Session persists across a page reload / repeated request
New tests exercise the current observable behavior of {{CRITICAL_MODULE}}
Mutating a core branch of the module makes at least one test fail (spot-check test teeth)
